plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Publication-prep tools for academic and public-facing writing. Four skills: style (17 canonical English-prose rules, 20 page-cap additions, 2 audit-time rules), preflight (deterministic pre-submission checks on a LaTeX tree), plot (18 matplotlib chart templates) and concept (3 schematic templates), the two figure skills sharing one design system under figures/: Google palette, venue-matched fonts, one header format, and the eleven-rule DOCTRINE.md.

plugins.name: anti-autoresearch
plugins.description: Integrity forensics for research papers, and the reviewer discipline for writing up what it finds. /anti-autoresearch builds a span-anchored evidence ledger, fans out 11 auditors, and hands every finding to a deterministic adjudicator: the model proposes, the adjudicator decides. Detect-only and observability-aware. Vendored from wanshuiyin/Anti-Autoresearch (MIT); support files under support/.

plugins.name: kexue-fm
plugins.description: 科学空间 kexue.fm（苏剑林博客）全站离线库：一个 SQLite（全文 Markdown、LaTeX 原样、标签、官方引用格式）+ 一个 kexue skill（多路检索 search、读全文 show、增量 sync）。
